lines.text: But they continued to sin against Him,
rebelling in the desert against the Most High.
by demanding the food they craved.
“Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness?
When He struck the rock, water gushed out
But can He also give bread
or supply His people with meat?”
so a fire was kindled against Jacob,
and His anger flared against Israel,
because they did not believe God

pictures.scene: David Teniers the Younger, El rey bebe — the whole table given over to drinking and shouting at the feast, and made water flow down like rivers, but they continued to sin against Him
pictures.name: pd_teniers_el_rey_bebe

pictures.scene: Carl Haag, Danger in the Desert — the riders out in the open sand with no shelter anywhere, rebelling in the desert against the Most High, they willfully tested God
pictures.name: pd_haag_danger_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Adriaen van Utrecht, Banquet Still Life — the table heaped with every good thing a man could ask for, by demanding the food they craved, they spoke against God saying
pictures.name: pd_vanutrecht_banquet_still_life

pictures.scene: Grigoriy Myasoyedov, The Zemstvo Dines — the men sitting on the step with their bread while the talk goes on inside, can God really prepare a table in the wilderness, when He struck the rock water gushed out
pictures.name: pd_myasoyedov_zemstvo_dines

pictures.scene: Jean-Baptiste-Siméon Chardin, La Pourvoyeuse — the woman come in from the market with the loaves she has carried home, and torrents raged, but can He also give bread
pictures.name: pd_chardin_la_pourvoyeuse

pictures.scene: Jan Weenix, Return from the Hunt — the game brought back and laid out at the end of the day, or supply His people with meat, therefore the LORD heard
pictures.name: pd_weenix_return_from_the_hunt

pictures.scene: Daniel van Heil, The Burning of Troy — the city taken and going up in flame from end to end, and was filled with wrath, so a fire was kindled against Jacob
pictures.name: pd_vanheil_burning_troy

pictures.scene: Jasper Francis Cropsey, The Clove Storm — the black weather breaking over the valley with the light shut out, and His anger flared against Israel, because they did not believe God
pictures.name: pd_cropsey_the_clove_storm

pictures.scene: Jan van Goyen, Polderlandschap — the low country lying under a sky that is nearly all of the picture, or rely on His salvation, yet He commanded the clouds above
pictures.name: pd_vangoyen_polderlandschap
